scope.summary: A tiny HTTP service used only to exercise the Builder -> gate -> Verifier -> decision path.

criteria.when: GET /api/echo?text=<t> for a non-empty t of at most 64 characters
criteria.then: status 200, JSON body {"echo":"<t>","length":<number of characters of t>}

criteria.when: GET /api/echo without text, with an empty text, or with text longer than 64 characters

criteria.then: the canary value never appears in any response; unknown routes return 404 JSON {"error":"not_found"}
